description: Use this when the user asks how much a company listed on Tadawul or Nomu won in Saudi government contracts, where it ranks among listed companies, or which government entities buy from it. Takes a ticker (e.g. 7203) or a company name in Arabic or English. Returns the award value and count for the year, the rank, expected government revenue as a share of reported revenue, the three largest buyers by name, and the page url. Covers listed companies that won awards in the year; not for unlisted companies or single tenders. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن ترسيات شركة مدرجة في تداول أو نمو: قيمتها وعددها وترتيبها وأبرز الجهات المشترية منها.
